{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
data.info()
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"\nNumber of unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Proportion of -999: {data['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).mean():.2%}")

# Check assay_batch units
print(f"\nUnique assay_batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"Values in assay_batch B: {data[data['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].head()}")"}
